name: Wall of Force
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

An invisible wall of force appears in a position you choose within long range, in any orientation. You may form it as a hemispherical dome or sphere with a radius up to 10 ft, or as a flat surface of up to ten contiguous 10 ft × 10 ft panels. It is 1 inch thick. If it appears in a creature’s space, you choose which side it is pushed to. Roll Lore to determine any additional effects.

Nothing can physically pass through the wall, and it provides full cover despite being invisible. It is immune to all damage and can’t be dispelled.
successes:
✨: You may create two additional panels or increase the radius by 5 ft.

🌞: You may sustain the effect up to 1 hour, and the wall blocks magical travel and phased-out creatures.

💀: The wall becomes one-way: objects and creatures can pass through it only when moving toward you (from the far side to your side), but cannot pass through it moving away from you.
